name: Ethics & Legal
description: Understanding of ethical boundaries, legal frameworks, and professional responsibilities in security testing and research. Covers rules of engagement, responsible disclosure, data protection obligations, NDA compliance, impartiality and confidentiality obligations (ISO/IEC 17025:2017 clauses 4.1 and 4.2), and the legal boundaries of security testing across jurisdictions.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to security ethics or legal frameworks

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands basic ethical principles and legal constraints on security testing
evidence: Completed ethics and legal awareness training
Can explain why rules of engagement and scope limitations exist
Understands NDA obligations
Can state the lab's impartiality and confidentiality obligations under ISO/IEC 17025:2017 clauses 4.1 and 4.2
Understands that testing requires written authorisation from the system owner, and that third-party or hosted systems in scope need authorisation of their own

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Operates within ethical and legal boundaries under supervision
evidence: Adheres to rules of engagement on all engagements
Escalates potential scope or ethical issues appropriately
Handles client data according to lab policies
Declares potential conflicts of interest before accepting an engagement assignment
Applies data-protection handling to personal data encountered during testing, minimising what is collected and retained

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently manages ethical and legal aspects of engagements
evidence: Confirms the authorisation basis for every target in scope before testing begins, including third-party and hosted systems, and withholds testing where it is absent
Identifies where an engagement is constrained by radio transmission licensing or safety-of-life considerations and confirms the applicable limits before testing
Identifies and escalates legal grey areas proactively
Handles responsible disclosure situations appropriately

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Advises on complex ethical situations; reviews rules of engagement; handles disclosure
evidence: Drafts or reviews rules of engagement for complex engagements
Advises team on ethical and legal edge cases
Reviews engagements for impartiality and conflict-of-interest risk and records the mitigation
Manages responsible disclosure processes

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines ethical framework; liaises with legal counsel; trains teams
evidence: Established or maintains the lab's ethical guidelines and legal framework
Liaises with legal counsel on complex situations
Delivers ethics and legal training to the team

assessment_methods.description: Scenario-based assessment: respond to ethical dilemmas (scope creep, accidental data exposure, responsible disclosure decision)
Observe adherence to rules of engagement and ethical practices during engagements
